events.verdict: Gobert (UTA) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Brown (DET) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Ingles (UTA) maintains a legal guarding position on Griffin (DET) at the start of the drive.
Gobert (UTA) makes contact to the arm of Griffin (DET) during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
Drummond (DET) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Mitchell (UTA).
Griffin (DET) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Ingles (UTA) when he slightly extends an arm to deliver marginal contact but does not dislodge Ingles.
{Observable in Enhanced Video} LATR shows Bullock (DET) steps out of bounds with his right foot before taking the shot.
Gobert (UTA) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Brown (DET) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Bullock (DET) places a hand/arm to the front of Mitchell (UTA) at the end of the drive but the contact does not affect his SQBR or ability to make his intended pass.
Ingles (UTA) could be deemed to be imminently exiting the lane within three seconds.
Jackson (DET) does not give Rubio (UTA) room to land on the jump shot attempt. Rubio lands on Jackson's foot and the contact causes him to go to the floor.
Drummond (DET) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Crowder (UTA) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Crowder (UTA) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Griffin (DET).
Gobert (UTA) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Brown (DET) when their arms engage and immediately separate.
Griffin (DET) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Mitchell (UTA) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Drummond (DET) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Favors (UTA) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Brown (DET) has a hand on the back of Mitchell (UTA) that slides onto Mitchell's hip but the contact is tactile in nature and does not affect his SQBR.
Brown (DET) commits a take foul on Mitchell (UTA).
Jackson (DET) commits a take foul on Rubio (UTA).
Ingles (UTA) maintains a legal guarding position on Drummond (DET) when he catches the errant pass from Jackson (DET).
Drummond (DET) makes marginal contact to the body of Ingles (UTA) as he steals the pass but does not affect his ability to maintain possession of the ball.
Jackson (DET) commits a take foul on Rubio (UTA).
